claim: Ready for Perun as a security audit product = the 'layered' bar in the packet (standards matrix + measured outcome recall + diff bench win + dependency currency + data/API gates + validated fixes + honest report contract + cost)
steelman: Only a layered bar matches the owner's ask (whole-project audit, deps current, API/data secured, standards alignment, confirm-or-fix) while staying falsifiable: each layer has a pre-registered pass/fail and none can certify 'secure'.

unsupported_claims.text: The layered bar's Fixes gate and standards-matrix gate use unfixed placeholder thresholds (Y% and X%), so they cannot be pre-registered as the packet requires. Until numbers are set, neither gate can fail, which weakens falsifiability.
unsupported_claims.quote: Ready = 0 items without a status and >= X% at (a) or (b).

what_would_change_it: If the re-measured real-repo recall after the 11-01/11-02 detectors reaches at least 50% in most gap classes, and a currency detector prototype shows 0 misses against npm/pip outdated output on 5 fixture repos in under a week, I would move to PASS_TO_USER on layered with the thresholds filled in. If the blind fixture authoring for vulnerable apps cannot be staffed, I would drop to standards-matrix plus outcome-recall.

A committed file (before measurement) that sets numeric X, Y and cost thresholds for the layered bar and gives a dollar and hour estimate for building the dependency-currency detector and the fix-validation runs, with the total under the owner's budget, would flip the verdict to PASS_TO_USER.

If X, Y, the per-class recall floor and the currency-detector spec are committed and pre-registered before measurement, and a post-11-02 re-measurement of real-repo recall shows no class at 0, I would move to PASS_TO_USER.

If the owner states that a staged 'ready' (honesty contract + outcome-recall first, with currency, fixes and standards matrix as named roadmap gates) is acceptable, I would move to PASS_TO_USER. A re-measure of real-repo recall after the 11-01/11-02 detectors showing no class at 0 would also strengthen approval.
verdict_basis: REVISE led the tally with 4 of 4 votes

premortems.text: Layered became a perpetual 'not ready' state: X and Y were set after seeing results, fixture sets drifted, the cost gate was measured against a scanner-less arm, and one weak gate (fix validation) blocked the verdict while no one shipped the currency detector. The team spent the budget on bench rounds instead of capability.

Six months out, layered stalled. The currency detector was never built, so the dependency gate was waived. The fix-validation runs exceeded the paid budget, and the thresholds were moved after the first results. The report then claimed coverage it did not measure.

Layered became a checklist that took months to reach. Gates were met on seeded fixtures and deliberately vulnerable apps, but real private repos still had blind classes (authz/IDOR, PII), so the report looked thorough and users read the absence of findings as safety. Alternatively the unset thresholds got tuned after seeing the results.

Layered bar becomes so large (matrix of ASVS L2 + Top 10 + API + CWE, currency detector, fix validation, bench n>=30) that it never passes; the owner gets no 'ready' label, or thresholds X/Y get set after seeing results, so the label is gamed and users trust a report whose coverage is thinner than the matrix implies.

kill_criteria: By 2026-12-15, if fewer than 5 of the 8 layered gates have a committed pre-registered threshold and a runnable fixture, drop the bar to standards-matrix plus outcome-recall and defer the rest.
If X, Y and the layered cost threshold are not committed as numbers by 2026-11-17, drop layered and adopt standards-matrix as the ready bar.

If by 2026-12-15 the thresholds X, Y and the recall floor are not committed and pre-registered, or the re-measured real-repo recall still has any gap class with >=5 manual findings at 0 detections, stop and cut scope to the outcome-recall plus report-contract layers.

If by 2026-12-15 the thresholds X and Y are not committed pre-registered and the dependency-currency detector has no passing fixture test, drop to outcome-recall plus report contract as the interim 'ready' bar.

By 2027-01-31, if the post-2026-11-01 real-repo run (--full plus skill audit on the private clones, counts only) shows any gap class with >=5 manual findings detected below 30%, halt the layered bar and revert to outcome-recall until that class is measured again.

leading_metric: Per-class recall on the private clones (counts only) for the zero-hit classes: authz/IDOR, injection, XSS, PII in logs.

twin.dissent: Pre-mortem, 2027-05-03: the layered bar was adopted, and six months on Perun is still not shippable. Its failure is in the gates, not the design. The bench gate is inherited unchanged: layered includes bench-only's A) requirement of n>=30 with >=6 decoys, but the only measured bench was n=8, with Wilson intervals of roughly 0.6-1.0, and the Perun arm was prose-only, so the scanners were never measured. The dependency-currency gate is measured against fixture repos, but there is no deterministic currency detector, so the gate largely tests the prose guidance and the 0-miss claim is unverifiable as written. The data/API gate requires an authn/authz verdict on every route, which is guided review without a seeded eval, and the packet has not shown that class (b) can meet a floor. The fixes gate is the most gameable: 'patch applies, tests pass, re-scan clears it' can be satisfied by a patch that disables the detector or adds a suppression, and the fix-validated rate is left as Y% and the standards threshold as X%, so the pre-registration the packet requires (constraint 5) is incomplete. Owner-fit is also overstated: the owner asked that every project 'align with best security practices' and be 'most secure'. A layered report of all gates passing will be read as 'secure' downstream, even though Perun never certifies that, and the report contract cannot control how the output is quoted. Earliest observable sign: the first post-2026-11-01 real-repo recall run on the private clones, reported as counts, still shows the authz/IDOR, injection, XSS and session classes below floor while the gates are reported as green on fixtures. Unverified: none of the post-11-01 detectors have been measured on real code, so this is the central unknown.
twin.kill_criterion: By 2027-01-31, if the post-2026-11-01 real-repo run (--full plus skill audit on the private clones, counts only) shows any gap class with >=5 manual findings detected below 30%, halt the layered bar and revert to outcome-recall until that class is measured again.

claims.text: The layered bar inherits the bench-only requirement of n>=30 with >=6 decoys, but the only measured diff bench was n=8 with a Perun arm that could only Read/Grep/Glob.

claims.text: There is no deterministic dependency-currency detector; the currency layer exists only as prose guidance, yet the layered gate is measured against fixture repos.
